findings.evidence: grep -rn 'Command input is incomplete|did not execute a complete command' apps packages tests tools → only TerminalPanel.tsx:392 and apps/playground/CHANGELOG.md:5; no test asserts the presenter failure. Honesty of result===undefined ⇔ incomplete holds by types: TerminalCommandPresenter.execute → Promise<number> (apps/playground/src/adapters/playground-terminal-ui.ts:22-28), runLine → Promise<number> (:73-81, returns run.exitCode), executeBuffer returns undefined only when the owner result is not a number or validation is incomplete (packages/terminal/src/terminal.ts:1424-1447).
findings.summary: Presenter failure 'Command input is incomplete (open quote or block); nothing executed' carries no test; the throw-on-undefined path predates this unit (BASE TerminalPanel.tsx:391) and the number-typed owner makes undefined equivalent to incomplete, so the message cannot mislabel an executed command. Advisory.

ADR-0431 §1 states 'Validation that leaves incomplete input returns undefined, never invented success' but not that an owned incomplete line is discarded (packages/terminal/src/terminal.ts:1425-1427); packages/terminal/CHANGELOG.md:5 cites the ADR for it. No contradiction; a dated one-line note would keep the ADR reading the shipped lifetime.
